notes.title: New Episode and Ending Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38667083/0634edf3328289defea85395e157236cae11e098.png

Hello everyone,
We just released Beyond Eden: Dear Edward 1.2.0 - a update that adds new episode and ending.

Memo: When Edward's job is "Explorer", reaching a Francis-related ending (one of Friend, Lover, or Triangle) can achieve a new ending graphic. 

Special Episode and Ending

 Added new special episode "Bathroom Mystery"
 Added new ending graphic for Francis, "Days of Exploration"
Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where scroll bars were not displayed in some categories of Achievements
 Fixed some unnatural sentences (You can report typo or unnatural sentences here) 

We hope you will enjoy a delightful Victorian life at Lane hall!

notes.title: New Event Graphics Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38667083/1bd88197c928216279ceee04622e8b28d97582de.png

Hello everyone,
We just released Beyond Eden: Dear Edward 1.1.0 - a update that adds new graphics.

Memo: If you have already seen the event, you can unlock the graphic by watching the event in the Replay menu. If new features are not added to the gallery, try restarting the game app. 

Event and Graphic

 Added animation to some weekly schedule graphics
 Added new event graphic for "Dance Partner"
 Added new event graphic for "Epilogue: How to be a Good Uncle"
 Added new feature in Gallery when collected all event graphics
 Added lines when Edward plays with Molly the cat 
Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where some replay thumbnails and event did not match
 Fixed some unnatural sentences (You can report typo or unnatural sentences here) 

We hope you will enjoy a delightful Victorian life at Lane hall!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38667083/7bee0b4f07bc17ee7ab720db5ee878156329442a.png

Hello everyone,
We have just released a hotfix to address a couple of issues.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where a text window was displayed for a short moment after executing a schedule
 Fixed an issue where the music volume was lowered when the history was opened and closed while a voice was playing
 Fixed an issue where the unlock message of Mini episode was not displayed after Alex & Joshua endings
 Fixed some lines and voice to match
 Fixed some typos and unnatural sentences (You can report typo or unnatural sentences here)

Event and Graphic

 Added graphic effect for Morris's Mini episode

Steam Achievement

 Fixed the title and description of some achievements to match


We hope you have a good time at Lane hall with Edward. Please enjoy!
